dedupe_keys.name: dataset of traffic dynamics during the 2019 kincade wildfire evacuation

description: The Lund University evacuation researchers publish California traffic measurements used to study the 2019 Kincade wildfire evacuation. Zenodo provides two Excel workbooks under CC BY 4.0, one for evacuation traffic and one for routine weeks. The deposit identifies California Department of Transportation Performance Measurement System data as the source and links a Transportation Research Part D article. The paired periods can support calibration of road loading and travel-delay assumptions during wildfire evacuation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Kincade event package. Coverage is the selected monitoring sites and weeks in the authors’ analysis, not all roads or household trips in the fire area. A limitation is that freeway detector measurements are not a direct count of people evacuating, and the page does not define all workbook columns or site-selection criteria. The article is a separate interpretation of the data. No workbook was downloaded or traffic profile reproduced.
